The fixtures in this directory were compressed by the system's gzip, so a test that decompresses
them checks the codec against a compressor it did not write itself.

text.txt.gz       gzip -9 -k text.txt          (its header names the file and its time)
text-1.txt.gz     gzip -1 -n -c text.txt       (no name, no time, the fastest level)
random.bin.gz     gzip -6 -n -k random.bin     (64 KiB that does not compress)
empty.gz          gzip -n of an empty file     (a member with no data)

Lines that repeat compress well:
the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

And text beyond ASCII: café, naïve, Ελληνικά, 日本語, 🎉, ℵ₀ < 2^ℵ₀.
0123456789 0123456789 0123456789 0123456789 0123456789 0123456789 0123456789 0123456789
